indicator.name: NASDAQ Composite RSI (14-day)
indicator.description: Wilder's 14-day Relative Strength Index of the NASDAQ Composite.
indicator.source_name: NASDAQ Composite daily closes (^IXIC), Wilder RSI
indicator.methodology: Wilder's RSI with a 14-period lookback, computed from daily NASDAQ Composite closing prices. The component is contrarian: lower RSI maps to a higher score through an inverse historical percentile. Conventional 30/70 reference levels are displayed.
indicator.limitations: RSI is a price-momentum measure, not a fundamental valuation measure. It can remain oversold or overbought for extended periods. The 30/70 levels are conventions, not statistically validated thresholds.
